title: An exact functor of abelian categories induces a triangulated functor on derived categories
statement: Let $F:\mathcal C_1\to\mathcal C_2$ be an exact (additive, preserving finite limits and colimits) functor between abelian categories, with derived categories $D(\mathcal C_1)$, $D(\mathcal C_2)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Applying $F$ termwise to complexes induces a functor $F:D(\mathcal C_1)\to D(\mathcal C_2)$ which is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category] (it commutes with the shift and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles) and which carries a complex $A[n]$ concentrated in one degree to $F(A)[n]$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma Tag 015F (label lemma-right-derived-exact-functor: an exact functor $F$ has $RF$ everywhere defined, computed termwise, and $RF$ is an exact functor of triangulated categories)
